page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review guidance — text and configuration only. Link a skill to any number of agents.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill in the editor, or import one from a .md or .zip file.

card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

drawer.subtitle: {type} · v{version}
drawer.notLinked: Not linked to any agent yet.
drawer.disabled: Disabled globally — not injected into any agent's prompt.

form.createSubtitle: A skill is text only: it is added to the prompt of every agent that links it.
form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: When the diff changes X, check that Y.
form.descriptionHint: The skill's interface. Write it as a directive: say when the skill applies and what to do.
form.bodyPlaceholder:
## Rule
Describe what the reviewer must check…
form.bodyHint: Injected verbatim under the skill's name in the agent's prompt.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip package. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.pickHint: Accepted: .md, .zip. From an archive only the markdown core (SKILL.md) is taken; nothing in it is ever run.
import.trust: An imported skill is someone else's instructions: its text becomes part of your agents' prompts. Read it before you enable it.

delete.title: Delete skill?
delete.body: “{name}” will be deleted and unlinked from every agent that uses it. This cannot be undone.

preview.intro: The body as an agent receives it, rendered.

versions.title: Versions
versions.subtitle: Every content change is saved as a new version. Restore writes the old body forward as a new version — history is never rewritten.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.restoreBody: The body of v{version} becomes the current body, saved as a new version.
